notes:
Top-level summary: ContextWell builds an IDE copilot focused on repo-aware completions and PR summarization. Wants embeddings + vector DB to be colocated with repo data (data residency).

Key ask: low-latency streaming from local dev to model — goal: <50ms per token for interactive completion in VSCode; P95 token latency target ~40ms for single-user flows. High throughput for batch repo search (target 120-200 QPS during index rebuild windows).

Repo landscape: monorepo + many small repos; private GitLab self-hosted behind customer VPC. Need connector that extracts chunked context with code-aware chunking (maintain function boundaries), embed at doc+symbol level. Interested in incremental embedding updates / fast upserts.

Vector DB preference: customer prefers self-hosted Milvus or Elastic Vector in VPC; strict requirement: vector indexes must stay in customer's cloud region, no cross-region replication without opt-in. They will consider Redwood Dedicated with private VPC peering or Redwood Private (on-prem appliance) depending on final SLA and packaging size.

Model/versioning: must be able to pin model versions per route; want automatic fallback to distilled/quantized variant when latency SLO breaches. Also require evaluation harness to detect semantic regression after each model rollout (they had a previous regression with another provider).

Security & compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning, KMS integration for key management, immutable audit logs for embeddings/access. Data retention controls: ability to TTL vectors older than X months and to purge on customer request.

Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for predictable latency and data residency, but wants Optimize recommendations to reduce token footprint (smart chunking, prefix caching).

Recent call notes (shorthand):
- 2026-01-12 initial intro demo w/ AE (Priya) + SE (Daniel). Showed hosted demo; CTO: "we need our vectors in our cloud".
- 2026-01-28 security deep-dive; requested SOC2 + KMS diagrams. Provided security Q&A (drive link).
- 2026-02-10 architecture workshop: decided on POC scope — repo connector, embedding pipeline, Milvus in VPC, model pinning.
- 2026-02-18 pricing + packaging; team asked for two options: Dedicated reserved pool vs Private (appliance). Requested TCO calc.
- 2026-02-25 pre-POC sync: agreed on datasets (2 small repos + one monorepo subset), timeline, acceptance criteria (latency, correctness on code search precision @10).

POC acceptance criteria (customer):
- Embedding upsert latency < 2s per 1k files in incremental mode.
- Vector query P95 < 30ms in VPC for matched vectors.
- Streaming token latency meeting <50ms for VSCode dev roundtrip.
- No vector data leaves customer region; audit log visible in console.

Notes about tech constraints: code-aware chunking required (prefer AST-based boundaries, not fixed 4k char windows). Must preserve symbol-level metadata in embeddings (filename, symbol path, commit hash). They want versioned embeddings to support rollbacks.

Sales ops: proposed 2-week paid POC (USD 12k) to validate latency & residency. AE asked legal to send small NDA. SE to provide PoC runbook + perf test harness.

Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "If you can match our latency and keep vectors in our VPC, we can replace current vendor and roll out to 500+ dev seats."
